gaps.lead: I can't deny that I was embarrassed to be given the award.
gaps.sentence: There's ___ embarrassment at being given the award.
gaps.explanation: 'There's no denying my embarrassment' = I can't deny I was embarrassed.

gaps.lead: It took the artist three weeks to paint the mural.
gaps.explanation: it took X time to do = X spent time doing: spent over three weeks on.

gaps.lead: Fewer students enrolled this year than we expected.
gaps.explanation: fewer than expected = not as many (students) as expected.

gaps.lead: Although he is remarkably rich, he lives very simply.
gaps.explanation: Although he may be rich → Rich as (he) may be — fronted adjective + as + may.

gaps.lead: He was sacked for constantly missing deadlines.
gaps.sentence: If he hadn't kept missing deadlines, he ___ sacked.
gaps.explanation: If + past perfect, would(n't) have been + participle.

gaps.lead: Someone stole her bike last week.
gaps.explanation: have something stolen/done = experience it happening to you.
